notes.title: Hogs Rampage - Steam Couch Co-Op Fest'25
notes.notes:
Hello everyone !

[b]Hogs Rampage[/b] is a co-op action game for 1-4 players where you hunt down destructive wild hogs. Team up in Couch Co-op or online, use creative weapons, and outsmart these smart, fast pigs as you navigate ever- changing terrains. It's a fast, chaotic, and hilarious race to stop the rampaging hogs.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45483625/d1c71231a8ca5b58f0de7f4201fce601f9b51980.png[/img]

Immerse yourself in fast-paced, hilarious chaos with [b]Hogs Rampage[/b]! Play couch co-op or online, coordinate with friends to trap and take down mischievous hogs. Who will be the ultimate hog catcher?

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3299140
